items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: Roy was the one giving me lessons on the trombone. Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer was giving me lessons.

ctx.x: You know him. Yeah, I remember Dutre. He was a very good tromboneer. Roy Palmer? Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer. We started out together, yeah. Roy Palmer was also. Oh, yeah. And I knew Roy and Trombone. Roy was the one giving me lessons on the trombone. Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer was giving me lessons. I told him I don't like the trumpet. I said, I want to play the trombone. He said, alright. I used to go to Roy's house every day. So, but the thing was, I'd be playing the trombone, you see, and the next day I got to play a…
How did Roy play in those days? Was he one of the best, I guess?
